name: Castle
flavor: Plain stone and stubbornness. It has never once had an idea, and it has never once fallen for lack of one.

name: Collapsed Mine
flavor: What's left of the vault is worth exactly one coin — but it's one coin nobody else starts with.

name: Plains Terrace
flavor: Open ground favors whoever steps onto it first. +1 Attack to the very first unit you play this match.

name: Outskirts Watchtower
flavor: The first thing anyone sees past the castle walls, and the last thing raiders want to.

name: Hedgerow Burrow
flavor: Dug deep under the thistles. Everyone who comes out of it is a little tougher.

name: Tidewall Fort
flavor: Every tide washes the cracks back full of sand.

name: Drowned Bellhouse
flavor: Half under water, and still somehow collecting rent.

name: Ashen Bastion
flavor: Built from cooled lava by someone who never once lost an argument.

name: Lantern Warren
flavor: A cave full of lanterns, and everything that flies towards them.

name: Acacia Kraal
flavor: Thorn walls, one shade tree, and a view of everything coming.

name: Wolfsbane Lodge
flavor: Logs as thick as a bear, and a fire that has never gone out.

name: Coral Spire
flavor: It grows a little every year. So does everyone who lives in it.

name: Bog Stilt-House
flavor: The swamp keeps trying to swallow it. The swamp keeps losing.

name: The Logjam
flavor: The beavers built it, the otters moved in. Nothing gets down this river in a hurry.

name: Trojan Horse
flavor: A gift, they said. On the third night it opened.

name: Ballista Keep
flavor: Two great crossbows on the battlements and a chipmunk who never sleeps.

name: Clam Farm
flavor: Otter beds of clams in the shallows. Every few days the harvest pays for another plank.

name: Thorn Cage
flavor: A fortress grown, not built. Every wall bites back.

name: Herb Refinery
flavor: Bubbling stills of mushroom and moss. Nobody knows what today's batch does until it boils over.

name: Hidden Nest
flavor: Woven into a thorn bush where no paw can reach. Every few days another chick fledges.

name: Farmstead
flavor: A barn, a fence and a cow who has seen everything. Easy to knock down; it keeps the Lumber coming (+1 every 2 rounds).

name: Village Green
flavor: A ring of cottages round a well. Everyone pitches in: every unit you play gets +1 Health.

name: Mossy Stump
flavor: An old stump that keeps growing back. Heals 1 Health every round.

name: Bramble Den
flavor: Hard to find, harder to reach. The enemy's first three units arrive 1 Wait later.

name: Driftwood Shack
flavor: Built from whatever the tide brought in. Start every fight with 1 extra Lumber.

name: Gull Rookery
flavor: Loud, smelly and well defended from above. Your Flying units get +1 Attack.

name: Gannet Ledge
flavor: A ledge only birds can reach. Your Flying units get +1 Attack.

name: Lighthouse
flavor: Its beam picks out a target every round: 1 damage to a random enemy unit.

name: Reed Raft
flavor: It floats, mostly. Heals 1 Health every round.

name: Otter Holt
flavor: A riverbank burrow full of cousins. Every unit you play gets +1 Health.

name: Mudbank Den
flavor: Anything that bites the bank gets bitten back: units that hit your castle take 1 damage.

name: Willow Hut
flavor: Hidden under the hanging willows. The enemy's first three units arrive 1 Wait later.

name: Sunken Chapel
flavor: Half under the black water, its bell still rings. Heals 1 Health every round.

name: Leech Pit
flavor: Nobody climbs in twice. Units that hit your castle take 1 damage.

name: Mushroom Ring
flavor: A fairy ring. Step inside and you come out richer: start with 2 extra Lumber.

name: Spore Tower
flavor: A tall puffball. The enemy's first three units arrive 1 Wait later, coughing.

name: Crystal Grotto
flavor: The crystals catch the light and throw it: 1 damage to a random enemy unit every round.

name: Bat Roost
flavor: A ceiling full of wings. Your Flying units get +1 Attack.

name: Mangrove Stilts
flavor: Roots in the water, house in the air. Heals 1 Health every round.

name: Crab Burrow
flavor: Every hole has a claw in it. Units that hit your castle take 1 damage.

name: Wrecked Ferry
flavor: The otters' old ferry, beached on the reef. Still full of planks: +1 Lumber every 3 rounds.

name: Reef Shelf
flavor: A shelf of coral that hides the young. Every unit you play gets +1 Health.
